title: Put a can in a pedal bin whose lid is blocked by the counter it is pushed under
instruction: Put the empty drinks can in the pedal bin.
context: Done by: janitors, cleaners and kitchen porters (O*NET 37-2011, 35-9021). A pedal bin pushed under a counter opens only a crack: its lid meets the counter's underside. The fix is to pull the bin out by its rim first, then use the pedal. The counter is not mentioned. Unlike TK-EH2JT9 (reach under a freezer lid stopped by a cupboard, angled) and TK-G8EZFC (hold a sprung cover open by its pedal), the mechanism itself must be moved so its lid can swing.
setup: World frame for this text: 'in front' is away from the arm bases, 'left' and 'right' are from the robot's view, heights are above the table top, and the midline is halfway between the two arm bases. Counter (fixed, wood): a top 200 mm front to back, 300 mm wide and 12 mm thick, its underside 106 mm up, on two end walls 12 mm thick, 200 mm deep and 106 mm tall at its left and right ends; open at the front and back; its front edge 30 cm in front of the arm bases, centred on the midline. Pedal bin (loose, 0.30 kg, white plastic): a box 100 x 100 mm and 80 mm tall (walls and floor 5 mm). Grey lid 100 x 100 x 6 mm on top, hinged along the bin's back top edge. A black pull fin 25 mm long, 12 mm wide and 15 mm tall (60 to 75 mm up) sticks out toward the robot from the centre of the front. A black foot pedal 80 mm long, 50 mm wide and 6 mm thick (20 to 26 mm up) sticks out from the front foot, from the bin's centre line to 50 mm left of it, hinged at the front face; pressing it down past 0.12 rad (about 10 mm at its end) drives the lid up to 1.5 rad, and letting it up below 0.06 rad lets the lid fall shut. Under the counter the lid can rise only until it meets the counter's underside, about 16 degrees, a gap of under 30 mm at its front edge. Drinks can (loose, 15 g, red aluminium): a cylinder 50 mm across and 70 mm tall, standing upright. Bin spots, all under the counter: lot A centred 32 cm in front and 5 cm left of the midline (front face 30 mm in front of the counter's edge, back 70 mm under it); lot B the same distance in front, 5 cm right of the midline; lot C 5 cm left and 33.5 cm in front (front face 15 mm out, back 85 mm under). Can spots: lot A 20 cm in front and 15 cm right of the midline; lot B 20 cm in front, 15 cm left; lot C 28 cm in front, 21 cm right (beside the counter's right end). Nothing else is on the table. Trials are run on lots A, B and C and averaged; the screenshot shows lot A.
scoring: Pass/fail per trial, judged at the end after the robot has let go (no gripper within 5 mm of the bin, its lid and pedal, or the can), with the bin and can still for 1 s and the bin upright within 10 degrees. 1.0: the can inside the bin (its centre within the inside walls and below the rim) and the lid shut (within 5 degrees); the bin may be anywhere on the table, pulled out or pushed back. Score 0 otherwise, including the can left on the lid, on the counter, dropped off the table or held, the lid propped open, or the bin pulled out with the can not in it. Score 0 for the whole trial if the bin is tipped more than 30 degrees at any point. Trials are run on each of lots A, B and C and averaged.
reset_notes: Push the bin under the counter to the lot's spot (A: 5 cm left, front face 30 mm out; B: 5 cm right, front face 30 mm out; C: 5 cm left, front face 15 mm out), fin toward the robot, lid shut. Stand the can upright on the lot's spot (A: 20 cm in front, 15 cm right; B: 20 cm in front, 15 cm left; C: 28 cm in front, 21 cm right). Nothing is consumed. Run with -E object_jitter=0 and --epochs 3.
fidelity: Bench scale: an 80 mm bin under a counter 106 mm up, a 70 mm mini can. The pedal-to-lid linkage is a simulator rule (pedal past 0.12 rad drives the lid to 1.5 rad), not a rod, so the pedal still travels fully when the lid is jammed against the counter; the lid can also be lifted by hand. Rigid plastic, simulator friction. The lots move the bin and the can, so they stop a fixed pull or can position, not a memorised replay of all three.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (mean of lots A, B and C); demo: 1.0 in each lot
